correctness.rationale: A complete planar half-diagram classification yields four gluing branch formulas for every prescribed target. Rank \(n-2\) has exactly \(3n-5\) intermediate compatible cap pairs; rank \(n-4\) fibers are governed by four delta expressions, with inclusion-exclusion on four equality events proving the seven permitted fiber values and all polynomial multiplicities. Counts sum to \((n-1)^4\). Independent graph-gluing enumeration and complete Catalan factor checking agree for all tested sizes \(n\le10\); the proof covers \(n\ge4\) rather than extrapolating tests.

originality.rationale: Actual relevant Jones monoid sources were inspected and distinguished by logical implication. East–Gray Section 9 provides rank-preserving principal-factor adjacency and ideal generators, not the unrestricted rank-decreasing prescribed-target fibers; Dolinka et al. enumerate idempotents instead of all ordered corank-two factor pairs. Published semantic record searches returned no statement with the four shape-dependent fiber formulas, forbidden fiber seven, or the seven-stratum table. This is qualified historical originality only: unsuccessful searches do not prove novelty; possible unindexed formulae remain a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or inaccessible general Temperley–Lieb planar-diagram structure-constant formula could imply the result.
Full text for some later potentially related algorithmic factorization studies was not available; no definitive comparison against all possible publications.
Published-record indexing is incomplete, and a failed search cannot establish universal historical uniqueness.

value.rationale: These are the complete multiplication structure constants of the first singular rank class in an unbounded natural family of finite diagram monoids. The shape-by-shape formulas and a missing fiber value \(7\) expose nonuniform target behavior invisible to rank-preserving adjacency or aggregate ideal generation. Exact multiplicities can be used to analyze multiplication operators and weighted diagram products; significance does not rest merely on finite code reproduction.
